storybound.preview.quest.description: Smoke rises beyond the pines. Find the village before nightfall.
storybound.preview.document.title: Watchman's Letter
storybound.preview.note.body:
The elder asked me to inspect the old mill.

Lights were seen there again after sunset. Tracks lead into the forest, but no villager dares go farther.

I must return to him before dawn.

storybound.preview.reader.title: The Northern Road
storybound.preview.reader.body:
**At the old crossing**

The road bends east beyond the mill. Before dawn, the watchman found fresh tracks in the mud and a lantern still burning beside the gate.

I have copied his directions here, so the next traveller can find the ford. Keep the river on your left until the broken milestone.

**Notes from the journey**

The bridge is gone. A narrow path leads between the birches; follow it to the shallow water.

*Written on the third evening.*

storybound.preview.scroll.title: To the Watch
storybound.preview.scroll.short: Keep the eastern gate closed until sunrise. The miller will bring a lantern when the road is clear.
storybound.preview.letter.body:
**My friend,**

The eastern road is clear. I left a lantern by the old mill and fresh bread in the watchman's chest.

Meet me at the crossing before sunset. Follow the river until you see the fallen birch.

*Keep this letter safe.*

**Tikhon**
storybound.preview.letter.title: A Letter from Tikhon
storybound.preview.contract.body: Howls have been heard near the old mill. Find their source and make the road safe before dusk.
storybound.preview.contract.hint: Tracks are easiest to follow at dawn.
